nodes.cisza.text.t: The Emperor waits for you to say something, then understands that you won't. He nods with gratitude, like a man offered one last decent way out. "Good. Enough words. I wrote them all my life and nobody ever read them to the end. All that's left is to watch."

nodes.danina.text.t: "Tribute." He repeats the word as if tasting it. "Twenty years ago I signed something I never read to the end. They wrote small, you know. I got order, roads without robbers, sleep without war. I paid in people nobody was counting. Had anyone asked me then, I'd have called it a fair price. Today I wouldn't agree, but nobody asks me."

nodes.dlug.text.t: "A debt? To whom, if not to me? To her? The one who heals the wound and takes the hand for it?" The Emperor laughs, quietly and without a trace of cheer. "You'll pay it or you won't. I've been paying mine for twenty years and the end's nowhere in sight."

nodes.komnata.options.[danina].text.t: I've seen the tribute. I know who takes it.

nodes.komnata.options.[dlug].text.t: I have a debt, Emperor. Not to you.

nodes.komnata.options.[szklo].text.t: I heard the record in the glass. I know about the pact.

nodes.komnata.options.[wola].text.t: I didn't come to beg. I came so you'd know it's me.

nodes.komnata.options.[zlecenie].text.t: I came for proof that I'm not dead. I don't mean to kill anyone.

nodes.komnata.text.t: The old man sits on the throne like a man in a coat too big for him. A cat sleeps on his lap, and in his hand he holds a pen and a notebook covered in tiny script. "Sit, if you're standing. No, don't sit, what for? You've come to kill me, haven't you? Everyone says so, and then they lose their nerve."

nodes.pakt.text.t: The Emperor sets down his pen. "So you know. A pact isn't an agreement, it's a sentence paid in instalments. My life is tied to the Core, and the Core feeds on my fear. Cut that thread with your blade and you won't have to kill me. I'll die on my own." He glances at your weapon. "A pity. I could have finished my tea before it went cold."

nodes.wola.text.t: The Emperor raises his eyes and for a moment looks like a man who once ruled. "You. Yes, I see it's you. There's something in your eyes I never had. A decision. Good. After twenty years someone has finally come with a decision instead of a plea." The cat stretches on his lap, as if approving.

nodes.zlecenie.text.t: "Proof? Ah, that trouble of yours." The pen scratches at the paper, though it writes nothing. "I had you wiped out because you saw. Not out of cruelty, out of fear that someone would believe you. And now here you stand, alive, with a blade that smells of stars. I can't tell whether I fear you more or envy you more."
